post.description:
Register a satellite app with Ducker ID. Generates an OAuth `clientId` and `clientSecret` — the secret is returned **once** in the response and will not be retrievable again.

**Authentication:**
- Requires valid Bearer token (admin role)

**Business rules:**
- `name` must be unique across all apps (lowercase, alphanumeric + hyphens)
- `categoryIds` must be 1-5 distinct existing categories
- `clientSecret` is bcrypt-hashed before storage; the plaintext is returned only in this response

name.description: Internal unique app name — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (min 2, max 64)

displayName.description: Human-readable name displayed in the portal (min 2, max 80)

iconUrl.description: Optional icon URL (must start with http:// or https://)

homeUrl.description: App home URL (must start with http:// or https://)

categoryIds.description: 1-5 distinct existing category ids, in display order (first = primary)

requiredRoles.description: Roles required to access this app

201.description: App registered successfully — includes one-time clientSecret

categoryIds.description: MongoDB _ids of the app's categories, in display order (first = primary)

clientSecret.description: Plaintext OAuth client secret — returned ONCE at creation. Store it securely.

404.description: Not found - Resource does not exist

409.description: Conflict — an app with this name already exists

get.description:
List registered apps for the admin console.

**Authentication:**
- Requires valid Bearer token (admin role)

**Filtering:**
- `search` — case-insensitive match on app name / display name
- `status` — filter by app status (`active` | `inactive`)
- `categoryId` — apps having this category among their categories (MongoDB ObjectId)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive keyword to match app name / display name

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the category to filter by

categoryIds.description: MongoDB _ids of the app's categories, in display order (first = primary)

patch.description:
Update one or more fields of a registered app. At least one field must be provided.

**Authentication:**
- Requires valid Bearer token (admin role)

**Business rules:**
- `name` must remain unique across all apps (conflict returns 409)
- `categoryIds` must be 1-5 distinct existing categories (otherwise 400 WEB_APP_CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND)
- Setting `status` to `inactive` pauses the app — it stays in the registry but is hidden from users' dashboards

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the app to update

name.description: Internal unique app name — lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only (min 2, max 64)

displayName.description: Human-readable name displayed in the portal (min 2, max 80)

iconUrl.description: Optional icon URL (must start with http:// or https://)

homeUrl.description: App home URL (must start with http:// or https://)

categoryIds.description: 1-5 distinct existing category ids, in display order (first = primary)

requiredRoles.description: Roles required to access this app

categoryIds.description: MongoDB _ids of the app's categories, in display order (first = primary)

404.description: Not found — app id does not exist (WEB_APP_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Conflict — an app with this name already exists (WEB_APP_NAME_EXISTS)

get.description:
List the active-app catalog for the launcher. Returns apps with `status=active`; OAuth internals and secrets are never exposed.

**Role-scoped visibility:**
- Admins receive the full active catalog.
- Non-admin users receive only apps whose `requiredRoles` include the `user` role (admin-only apps are hidden).

**Authentication:**
- Requires valid Bearer token (any authenticated user)

**Query params:**
- `page` — 1-based page number (default 1)
- `limit` — page size (default 12, max 100)
- `search` — case-insensitive match on name / display name / description
- `categoryId` — apps having this category among their categories (MongoDB ObjectId)

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: MongoDB ObjectId of the category to filter by

categories.description: In the order the admin chose; the first is the primary

slug.description: Derived from name.en; changes when name.en changes
